## Problem

The #593 stack-mode rework (PR #619) was verified with real git against a bare origin but a stubbed `gh`. The sign-off deferred live-host validation to a follow-up ("live GitHub validation deferred to a follow-up", iteration-6 carry-forward; PR #619 "Not checked live"). It was never filed. The note was written in §10 at the round-6 iterate and lost when the next Check rebuilt SUMMARY (#608).

Not yet exercised on a real GitHub repo:

- Siblings A and C in wave 0, B depending on both; merge A and C with merge commits; inspect B's "Files changed" and the "Update branch" remedy.
- A merged-and-deleted prerequisite: a real `gh pr view --json state,headRefOid` response after merge + branch delete, read by `merged.merged_head` (`template/src/pdca_harness/merged.py:62-76`).

The round-1 reviewer's recipe is in `results/issue_593/iteration-v1/check-review.md` (pdca-pdca).

## Done when

The scenarios above are run on a disposable GitHub repo with merge commits enabled, and the result (diffs shown, `gh` JSON shape) is recorded here. Any mismatch is filed as a bug.

Found by the eduralph/pdca-pdca Act review of 2026-10-02 (issue_593 iteration-v6 §10, lost to #608).
